coverage_definition: All retained timestamped speech was read, including introductions, presentations, Q&A and closing segments. For reading, lines were joined into paragraphs with one retained timestamp per minute; no caption speech was omitted. Coverage means complete retrieved captions, not continuous or independently audio-verified original-video coverage.

limitations: English auto-captions, not audio-verified; specialist words and prices may be mistranscribed.
Spoken chart descriptions reviewed; no video chart frames inspected.
Historical platform features, presenter probability claims and inferred motives not independently validated.
